faqs.title: How do I save my Progress?
faqs.body:
If you are on App Version 4.3.02 or above, you can sync your progress online and play across devices.

  • Go to Settings → Account
  • Choose Facebook, Google, or Apple to sync your account
  • Once linked, you can log in with the same provider on any device to continue where you left off

Your progress is always saved locally on your device as well, but syncing makes sure it is backed up and available on other devices.

Note: If you are on a version below 4.3.02, your progress will only be saved locally and cannot be transferred to another device.

faqs.title: How do I find my user ID?
faqs.body:
You can find your User ID by following these simple steps:

1-Head to the main menu of the game

2-Tap on the settings icon at the top right corner of the screen

3-Your User ID will be at the bottom of the settings panel. You'll see a small "copy" icon next to the User ID, tap on it to copy your ID automatically.

faqs.title: How do I change my name from “User###” to whatever?
faqs.body:
• You can change your username by pressing on your avatar found in the main menu
  • A username doesn't have to be unique and you can set it as anything you like!
  • Make sure you don't use any offensive words in your username

faqs.title: How do I change language in the game?
faqs.body:
You can easily select the language of your choice within the game.

Step 01 - Navigate to the settings panel found in the top right corner of the main menu.

Step 02 - Tap on the Select Language Button

Step 03 - Select your desired language from the available languages.

faqs.title: How do I transfer my Progress to another device?
faqs.body:
Account syncing is now available for app version 4.3.02 and above.

 

Creating a Save

  • To create your save, please access your Settings Menu (the gear icon at the top right), select "Save Progress" and select either Facebook\Apple or Facebook\Google (depending on your device you are logged into).

 

Transferring the progress to a new device

  • On your old device, open the game and go to Settings → Account.
      • Sync your progress with Facebook, Google, or Apple.
    1. On your new device, install and open the game.
      • Go to Settings → Account and log in with the same provider you used on the old device.

    Note: If you haven’t synced your account with Facebook, Google, or Apple, your progress will only be stored locally and cannot be transferred to another device.

faqs.title: How do I recover my account?
faqs.body:
• For version 1.6.50 you can save your progress locally on a device
  • This is only possible if you have deleted the game but not your account
  • Make sure your internet is connected so that the account can be recovered locally
  • Simply Reinstall the game on the same device to recover your account

To Recover your account on a new device

  1. On your old device, open the game and go to Settings → Account.
    • Sync your progress with Facebook, Google, or Apple.
  2. On your new device, install and open the game.
    • Go to Settings → Account and log in with the same provider you used on the old device.
